programme.title: Dawn Patrol
programme.desc: When a blue-collar surfer avenges his brother's murder, he discovers he killed the wrong man by mistake and joins the Marines to escape his past, only to face it at gunpoint in a distant desert, where he must survive a captor bent on revenge.

programme.title: Megaworld
programme.desc: There’s more to Argentina than wine and beef, in fact this South American country is carving out a reputation as a major industrial nation. MegaWorld visits IMPSA, home of the world’s largest milling machine where huge hydro-electric turbines are being machined and the oldest shipyard in South America where they can repair up to five ships at a time.

programme.title: Megaworld
programme.desc: There’s a lot more to Austria than Mozart and the Von Trapp singers. Travel to the top of the Austrian Alps to see how a ski resort protects itself from deadly avalanches, watch World Champion air racer Hannes Arch pull 12 Gs in his aircraft as he trains for the upcoming season, and witness armoured vehicles survive the most violent explosions.

programme.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
programme.desc: It's fun times as host Tommy Little is joined by cast members Rhys Darby, Steen Raskopoulos, Cal Wilson and Bridie Connell for the improvisation game show where everything's made up and the points don't count. Games include scenes from a Hat, Hollywood Director, Dating Service, Dubbing, Bartender, Newsflash, Rock Song
